Dear Tinder Team,

I'm applying for the Product Internship - New Experiences in Ghent. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I've spent the last years building websites, running experiments, and using data to understand what makes people click, connect, and stay. Tinder's mission to bring people together and your focus on new forms of discovery resonate with me.

In my freelance work, I designed and built baverok.com from scratch, including a hand-coded landing page and a free site-check enquiry flow. At Episto, I run SEO experiments for client sites, using tools like Semrush and Google Analytics to test hypotheses and iterate. I've also developed an Android app live on Google Play, so I understand the full product cycle from idea to launch.

I'd love to contribute to an experiment that helps users find people in a new way. My mix of user-focused thinking, technical skills, and hands-on testing experience would let me dive right in.

Thank you for considering my application.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Tinder Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Product Internship - New Experiences in Ghent. Tinder's mission to bring people together and create meaningful relationships has always stood out to me, and I'm excited by the team's focus on designing innovative features that enable new forms of discovery. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I've spent the last years building websites, running experiments, and using data to understand what makes people engage.

In my freelance work, I designed and built baverok.com from scratch, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero and a free site-check enquiry flow. This project taught me how to take a product from idea to live implementation, always with the user in mind. At Episto, I run SEO experiments for client websites, using tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics to test hypotheses and iterate based on results. I've also developed an Android app that is live on Google Play, which gave me hands-on experience with the full product lifecycle, from concept to launch and monitoring.

What draws me to this internship is the opportunity to work on an experiment that helps users find people in a new way. I enjoy starting with user problems, forming hypotheses, and translating them into features that can be tested and refined. My experience with user interviews, surveys, and usability testing—though primarily in a marketing context—has given me a solid foundation in evidence-based decision-making. I'm eager to apply these skills in a multidisciplinary product team and learn from Tinder's state-of-the-art mobile and backend technologies.

I'm confident that my mix of user-focused thinking, technical skills, and hands-on testing experience would allow me to contribute meaningfully to your team. I'm excited about the possibility of working in an international, agile environment and making an impact on an app with millions of users worldwide.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Tinder's New Experiences team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:

• Ran SEO experiments and A/B tests for client sites at Episto, using Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics to form hypotheses and iterate based on data.
• Developed an Android app live on Google Play, gaining hands-on experience with the full product lifecycle from concept to launch.
• Conducted user research through surveys, interviews, and usability testing in a marketing context, informing feature improvements and content strategies.
• Worked in multidisciplinary teams at Knowledge Experts (KXP) on digital workplace sites for major clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, collaborating with developers and designers.
